A. Bonalu is celebrated during the Ashada month to worship Goddess Mahakali.
B. Peerla Panduga is celebrated by both Muslims and Hindus during the month of Muharram.
C. Ugadi marks the Telugu New Year and involves the preparation of Ugadi Pachadi containing six distinct tastes.

questions.explanation_english: British colonial architectural styles in India evolved sequentially starting with Neo-Classical style in the late eighteenth century. 95. Which traditional ritual craft of Telangana
involves creating intricate geometric floral
designs on the floor using white chalk powder or
rice flour during festivals?
questions.explanation_english:
Muggu is the traditional ritual floor art form
practiced widely across households in Telangana
and Andhra Pradesh. Drawn using white rice
flour or limestone chalk powder, women create
geometric grids, dots, and intricate symmetric
floral patterns at doorstep entrances during daily
dawn rituals and major festivals. It symbolizes
welcoming prosperity, driving away evil spirits,
and feeding small birds and insects with rice
powder.

आटे या चूना चाक पाउडर का उपयोग करके
बनाया जाता है, महिलाएं दरवाजे के प्रवेश द्वार
पर ज्यामितीय ग्रिड, बिंदु और जटिल सममित
पुष्प पैटर्न बनाती हैं। यह दैनिक सुबह की
अनुष्ठानों और प्रमुख त्योहारों के दौरान किया
जाता है। यह समृद्धि का स्वागत करने, बुरे
आत्माओं को दूर करने और छोटे पक्षियों और
कीड़ों को चावल के आटे से खिलाने का प्रतीक

questions.explanation_english: The chronological evolution of Deccan architectural styles begins with Satavahana rock-cut architecture between second century BCE and second century CE. Badami Chalukya architecture flourished from the sixth to eighth centuries, pioneering structural temple designs. Kakatiya architecture developed between the twelfth and fourteenth centuries with distinct star-shaped plans and sandbox foundations. Qutb Shahi Indo-Islamic architecture emerged during the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries in the Golconda region.
